list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Three (C5Me5)2Sm units are joined by three bridging chlorides in a planar six-membered Sm3(μ-Cl)3 ring. The paired pentamethylcyclopentadienyl rings at each Sm center are staggered.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, (C5Me5)2SmCl(THF) (0.85 g, 1.6 mmol) was heated in a stopcock-fitted tube under dynamic vacuum (about 10^-5 torr) for 36 h at 90 °C to remove THF. The orange-red product was recovered in an ether-free glovebox.
synthesis.temperature: 90 °C for desolvation; room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Stopcock-fitted tube on a vacuum line; hexane layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Recovered 0.61 g of product. X-ray-quality crystals were grown by layering hexane over a saturated solution prepared in hot toluene.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystal contains a trinuclear samarium cation and a dinuclear samarium anion. In the cation, a chloride-bridged Sm2 unit is linked through tetraglyme to a third (C5Me5)2Sm unit; four tetraglyme oxygen atoms coordinate to samarium in total. The anion consists of two (C5Me5)2ClSm units joined by one bridging chloride.

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, (C5Me5)2SmCl(THF) was desolvated under vacuum at 150 °C for 1 h, heated at 175 °C for 30 min, and sublimed at 165 °C for 3 days. Sublimed material was stirred in toluene. The decanted solution was layered with hexane containing a trace of tetraglyme.
synthesis.temperature: 150 °C for 1 h; 175 °C for 30 min; sublimation at 165 °C
synthesis.time: 1 h desolvation; 30 min heating; 3 days sublimation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Vacuum desolvation, sublimation, and solvent layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The toluene solution was decanted into a loosely capped vial and layered with hexane containing tetraglyme. Crystals remained after solvent evaporation.
